title: Basa - Tandoori Spicy Fish
preamble:
1/2 teaspoon ground cumin

1/2 teaspoon ground coriander

2 teaspoons ground garam masala

2 teaspoons sweet Paprika

1/2 teaspoon hot Chilli powder - or 1/2 teaspoon gochaguru powder
method: In a large bowl add yoghurt and half of the paste, mix well and coat the basa fillets. Set aside.
Heat the oven to Gas Mark 5
Wrap the fish, complete with marinade, loosely in foil and bake for about 20 minutes - check it is cooked before serving
